_doc: Registry of the cloud-me-pub hub. A SUBSET of repo_master/repos.json (_git-repos-master), narrowed to the public cloud-me family (Cloud-Me-Pub). Identical name/url/private/doc fields to that superset; the two must not disagree. This repo is an INDEX, not a container - see clone.sh for the clone/link model.
base_dir_doc: Clones live outside this index, as siblings in $CLOUD_GIT_BASE (default ~/git). This repo holds only committed symlinks pointing at them.
_visibility_doc: private:true repos require SSH access configured for this GitHub account to clone.

repos.name: cloud-me-pub-profiles
repos.doc: Hub of the cloud-me-pub-profiles family (Leaf.y, Nexus.z, Stark.x, Prf-Prs, _Lnktree): its own repos.json subset plus committed symlinks, same model as CG, Fin-CM and cloud. Was cloud-me-profiles (the b_Profiles, Lnktree and myAstro sources); content split into cloud-me-pub-profiles-prf-prs and cloud-me-pub-profiles-_lnktree 2026-10-28.

repos.name: cloud-me-pub-shared
repos.doc: Sources of the b_MyData group, split from front-projects (#1072); snapshot copy, paths mirror the original layout.

_root_doc: No entries carry a group field - every member links at the root of this index, same as CG and Fin-CM.
